residency_notes.dk_share_income: Directly held shares are generally share income in Denmark: 27% up to DKK 79,400 and 42% above for 2026. The threshold and household rules can change.
residency_notes.dk_abis_list: Investment funds on Denmark's approved tax list are generally taxed each year on gains before sale as share income.
residency_notes.dk_non_abis_capital_income: Funds outside Denmark's approved tax list, often including Indian mutual funds and exchange-traded funds, may be taxed each year on gains before sale as capital income. Check each fund's classification.
residency_notes.dk_aktiesparekonto: The Danish share savings account is taxed at 17%; its 2026 deposit cap is DKK 174,200. Check your available room and eligibility.
residency_notes.dk_pension_pal: Danish pension returns are generally subject to PAL tax; SKAT lists a 15.3% rate. Your arrangement may differ.
residency_notes.dk_worldwide_income: Danish tax residents may need to report worldwide income. Treaty relief can apply; NRE/FCNR interest exempt in India may still be taxable in Denmark.
residency_notes.dk_abis_check: Check whether the selected fund appears on Denmark's current tax list.
residency_notes.dk_fund_tax_review: Review existing Indian mutual funds and ETFs for Danish tax treatment; this note does not recommend selling them.
residency_notes.dk_use_ask_first: Consider the Danish share savings account first for new eligible equity investments, up to your available contribution room.
residency_notes.eu_priips_kid: EU rules for retail investors require a key information sheet. Your broker decides which products are available.
residency_notes.ppf_nri_eligibility: NRIs should not add new PPF contributions. Existing accounts may have maturity and extension limits; confirm the account's specific treatment.
residency_notes.small_savings_nri_eligibility: NRIs are generally not eligible to open small-savings accounts. Existing-account treatment can depend on the scheme and date; confirm before acting.
residency_notes.epf_residency_review: EPF and VPF eligibility depends on employment and scheme circumstances; confirm with EPFO before changing contributions.
residency_notes.nps_nri_eligibility: PFRDA permits eligible NRIs to subscribe to NPS Tier I; NRIs cannot activate Tier II.
residency_notes.bank_fd_residency_review: A resident bank deposit may need to be redesignated after a change in FEMA status. Check with the bank.
residency_notes.direct_equity_nri_pis: If you live outside India, buying Indian shares directly may require bank approval and follow foreign-exchange rules. Confirm the process with your bank.
residency_notes.nri_mutual_fund_eligibility: NRI access to Indian funds depends on fund, investor, and account circumstances.
residency_notes.sgb_residency_review: Sovereign Gold Bond subscription eligibility is restricted by residency; review existing holdings and the current issue terms.
residency_notes.gsec_nri_eligibility: Eligible non-resident retail investors may access Indian government securities under applicable RBI/FEMA rules.
residency_notes.frsb_nri_eligibility: NRIs cannot subscribe to RBI Floating Rate Savings Bonds. Existing holdings need individual FEMA review.
residency_notes.nri_capital_gains_tds: TDS may be withheld on NRI investment proceeds. Current listed-equity planning rates are 20% for short-term gains and 12.5% for long-term gains; final tax depends on the transaction and current law.
residency_notes.nre_interest_exempt_in_india: Qualifying NRE deposit interest is exempt from Indian income tax while FEMA eligibility conditions are met.
residency_notes.fcnr_interest_exempt_in_india: Qualifying FCNR(B) deposit interest is exempt from Indian income tax; currency and bank availability should be checked.
residency_notes.nro_interest_tds: NRO deposit interest is taxable in India and may have tax deducted at source.
residency_notes.rnor_foreign_income_window: A returning Indian resident's temporary tax status can depend on being non-resident in 9 of the previous 10 years, or spending 729 days or fewer in India during the previous 7 years. Foreign-income treatment depends on its source and circumstances.
residency_notes.resident_only_lrs_tcs: Overseas transfer and tax collection rules apply to people who live in India for tax purposes. They do not apply to this non-resident plan.
residency_notes.resident_only_schedule_fa: People living outside India or qualifying returning residents may not need to complete the foreign-assets section of the Indian tax return.
residency_notes.pfic_avoid: US taxpayers may face special tax and reporting rules for non-US pooled funds. Review before buying new Indian mutual funds or exchange-traded funds.
residency_notes.pfic_holding_review: Review existing Indian mutual funds and exchange-traded funds for special US tax reporting. This note does not recommend selling them.
residency_notes.fbar_fatca_reporting: US taxpayers may need to report foreign accounts when total balances pass a threshold. Check current US account-reporting rules.
residency_notes.us_tax_applies: US tax and reporting may apply to NRE and FCNR interest even when it is exempt in India. No US tax is calculated here.
residency_notes.fcnr_currency_check: Confirm the FCNR(B) currency with the selected bank. Use EUR as a fallback if DKK is not offered.
residency_notes.local_deposit_tax_review: A local DKK/EUR deposit rate is not available in the plan. Check the institution, current rate, deposit protection, and tax treatment.
residency_notes.tax_residence_country_may_apply: Tax in your country of residence may also apply; this plan does not calculate it.
residency_notes.estate_tax_us_domiciled_assets: US-situated assets may be included in a US estate-tax calculation. Citizenship, domicile, asset type and treaty rules matter.
residency_notes.residency_country_unavailable: This saved residence country is outside the currently supported choices. Review your residence details before using country-specific guidance.
residency_notes.clubbing_check: In India, income from money you give your spouse can be taxed as your income. Invest from their own income or savings, or keep records of a loan.
